summary: Frontend-only landing page for Kodeveill tested end-to-end via Playwright at the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All requested features work: page loads without console errors after the ~1.6s loader, sticky navbar smooth-scrolls to all sections, hero primary/secondary CTAs scroll to contact/portfolio, trust counters animate to 20+/100%/100%/99+, 10 service cards render, 6 portfolio cards render with correct netlify hrefs and target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer, 6 process steps present, 3 testimonials, FAQ accordion expands (Radix single-collapsible), contact form prevents reload, shows contact-success div + sonner toast 'Thank you! Your message has been received.', fields clear on submit, required validation is present via HTML required attributes on inputs/textarea, contact quick buttons have correct mailto/tel/wa.me hrefs (WhatsApp has target=_blank), back-to-top appears past 700px scroll and returns scrollY to 0, scroll-progress bar present, and mobile menu (viewport 390x844) opens/closes and scrolls to sections.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact form uses noValidate on the <form>, so HTML5 required validation UI is suppressed; the required attributes still block accidental empty submission in some browsers but the visible native validation bubble is disabled. If a visible error state on empty submit is desired, add custom validation (currently the submit handler will succeed even if fields are empty because noValidate + no JS validation). Consider removing noValidate or adding explicit JS validation for a polished UX.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This app is frontend-only. Do NOT test /api. Wait ~2.5s after navigation for the 1.6s loader plus Lenis smooth-scroll setup. Trust counters take ~3s to finish animating. Back-to-top requires scrollY>700 to appear. Mobile menu appears below 1024px viewport. All important selectors are data-testid based (see review request for full list). Contact form is a simulation and never issues a network request.
